title: Not a Hill
hook: That is not a hill. It's awake.
question: Would you look at the hill, or close your eyes?
synopsis: The last train creeps past a dark round hill by the lake. The lamps die near it. Then the hill stands up.
lines: The lamps die when we pass it.

gate.premise: A dark hill by the line has eyes; it stands up and it is the Hush.
gate.pattern: P1 scale reveal (not used by the last two posts: P4/P5, P6/P5)
gate.frame0: A huge dark round hill fills the top of the phone screen with two lit pale green eyes, Rook small below, hook 'That is not a hill.'
